notes.title: We have a new trailer!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

[h2]We have prepared a new trailer for you![/h2]

This time we focused on combat! In The Path of Calydra you can use multiple abilities and fighting styles drawing their power from the natural elements like fire, wind or water!

Additionally, you can chain different attacks and switch your entire fighting style in the middle of combat!
We are more than sure, that our fans will come up with some new combos and interesting tactics!

[h3]Check it our here:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=s-aQIDdy-gE;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to be always up to date - consider following us on social media [url=https://linktr.ee/thepathofcalydra]here[/url] and wishlisting our game if you haven't.

notes.title: Ent Boss Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

[h3]Today we'd like to share with you some footage of Matheus clashing against the mighty Earth Ent boss![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/ce785d6f8d009b50084e50172532150b939e5419.png[/img]

We believe that boss encounters in games are very important, but we don't want to overdue it with dozens of not-meaningful and lesser bosses. 
Instead - we focused on couple of them, and each one represents a different part of the world that you will traverse during your adventures!

[h3]Take a look at the trailer and let us know what do you think![/h3]

[previewyoutube=KQ8XRwTfinM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Thank you for 7 years of support.
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]
[h3]We have something special for you today...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/d108eff067ef4ce6b165e16f59ff6cd46db85d2d.png[/img]

Our game is developed for 7 years so far...
It's been a long journey, we have learned a lot and improved a lot as well, but it would not be possible without [b]you[/b] and our families along with friends...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/ecb2a4b45435d713e992d9758bce3763087ab12a.png[/img]

A massive thank you from the bottom of our hearts to all of the people that made our passion flourish and kept us motivated. Hats off!

Since we have reached the alpha stage of the game, we're closer than ever to make it released.

To cherish all the memories and the people involved in this adventure we have prepared an appreciation trailer:

[previewyoutube=KhExoeASkxU;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to be always up to date - consider following us on social media [url=https://linktr.ee/thepathofcalydra]here[/url] and wishlisting our game if you haven't.

See you all very soon with another announcements!

notes.title: The Path of Calydra has reached alpha!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello gamers![/h2]

[h3]We have a very special announcement for you today![/h3]

The Path of Calydra officially has reached the alpha stage!
It means that the game is playable from start to the finish. Our team has made a big progress in development and we're looking forward to the grand premiere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/797d128cb4ba398b5d8128975e434c840e66b74d.png[/img]

We need to tweak some things and add some features, but we're getting closer with each passing week!
Let's celebrate it with a new video!

[previewyoutube=NH1w3osw5c8;full][previewyoutube=NH1w3osw5c8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Consider visiting our social media [url=https://linktr.ee/thepathofcalydra]here[/url] to be up to date with our development!

notes.title: Taipei Game Show nomination!
notes.content:
[h2]We have great news to share with you![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/a6fd4de23b277eca79a957963292983f45e79921.png[/img]

[h3]We are very proud to announce that we are nominated in the 
"Best Visual Art" category for Indie Game Awards 2023 during the 
Taipei Game Show![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/43477d9cdb911f4525fb16befe1bcf62f8462475.png[/img]

It's another important milestone in our journey and a truly heartwarming experience.
The Path of Calydra is being developed for 7 years so far and both teams - Varsav Game Studios and FinalBoss - are very proud with the current state of the game, but every single award, nomination and positive feedback from our beloved community is worth more than gold to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/d019b53e263e46bbff18c857bbafd12132643aae.png[/img]

You are the force that help us creating this beautiful world, characters and mechanics - and for that we are very greatful.
We have no intention of stopping anytime soon, so keep you eyes open for new things to come!

Follow us on our social media for daily updates!
https://linktr.ee/thepathofcalydra

notes.title: New The Path of Calydra Collectible Cards
notes.content:
[h1]In-game Collectible Cards[/h1]

We have shared our collectible cards some time ago, but we have plenty more stuff to show you!

Just a quick reminder - in The Path of Calydra there are many collectible cards scattered around the world, that you can find if you look carefully and explore every corner of our beautiful world. Try to find them all!

Today we are showcasing two more sets: one being dedicated to Halloween with some spooky critters, and the second one is focused on primordial soul of Calysgore - the mighty Calydra herself!

[h2]Set #4[/h2]

notes.content:

Have some fun, watch scary movies and hoard a massive amount of sweets during your Trick or Treat hunting! Don't forget that we have our demo available, so share it with your friends after you've done scaring people!

[b]Here's a piece of spooky Calydra artwork that we've prepared for you:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38621846/8df782d3eddd405aec6bf507bb85cb280458c377.jpg[/img]

Feel free to use it as your wallpaper to make this ghastly season of the year last a little bit longer!
